jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Build a Career That Builds Your Future — with PulteGroup!

Welcome to PulteGroup where we believe in building more than just homes—we believe in building inspired employees, meaningful careers, and a legacy of excellence. If you're looking for work that moves you, a team that values your ideas, and a company that brings you pride, you’ve come to the right place.

As one of the nation’s largest and most respected homebuilders, PulteGroup offers opportunities to grow within a Fortune 500 company that’s consistently recognized as a Fortune 100 Best Company to Work For and a certified Great Place to Work. We’re driven by the bold purpose of Building Incredible Places for People to Live Their Dreams.

For over 70 years, we’ve been building more than homes—we’ve been building trust, innovation, and a culture where every team member is empowered to thrive. Join a company that champions inclusion, celebrates diversity, and supports your personal and professional journey.

Headquartered in vibrant Atlanta, Georgia, and operating in over 45 markets nationwide, we’re proud to build homes through our trusted family of brands—including Innovative Construction Group, Centex, Pulte Homes, Del Webb, DiVosta Homes, American West, and John Wieland Homes and Neighborhoods, Pulte Mortgage, PGP Title, Pulte Insurance Agency —all united under the PulteGroup name.

Apply now and discover a career where your contributions are valued, your growth is supported, and your work makes a lasting impact

This position requires onsite attendance 5 days per week at our Division Office located in Medina, Ohio.

A key collaborative partner of the Division leadership team, the Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and executing a sound marketing strategy to deliver a sufficient volume of qualified leads necessary to meet Division net sign-up goals.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Leads all marketing planning, efforts and execution for the Division.
- Oversee and manage Marketing Team direct report(s).
- Collaborate with Division leadership on status of marketing strategy, results, and calls-to-action/offers.
- Ability to analyze business problems and make thoughtful recommendations as it pertains to marketing strategies and tactics.
- Demonstrates understanding of the role of paid, owned and earned media channels and how to effectively message across a mix of media types.
- Monitors marketing performance against business objectives, analyzes ROI and adjusts plans/tactics as needed.
- Produce weekly and monthly KPI reports for use by Division, Area and Home Office leadership.
- With support of corporate media planning resources and in collaboration with Division/Area leadership, develop and approve annual marketing and media budget necessary to deliver plan.
- Effectively manage Division budget(s) on an on-going basis with formal quarterly updates detailing brand & community actual and projected investment.
- Establish lead goals by brand & community to achieve Division net sign-up plan, given local conversion and cancellation rates. Monitor progress against goals.
- Develop marketing communications plan(s), including community priorities, advertising support needs, and message/offer strategy.
- Collaborate with Division personnel for new community set-ups to ensure that the Division hits critical milestones, including target opening dates.
- Act as primary point-of-contact for Pulte Interior Design.
- Collaborate with corporate communications team on local PR needs.
- Identify key competitors and stay abreast of local marketing activity.
- Ability to successfully operate and adapt in an environment with changes to timelines and priorities
- Capable of presenting and interacting with the Division/Area leadership with some ability to talk off script when answering marketing questions.

MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES
- Ability to develop and guide direction of a marketing team
- Ensures appropriate staffing to meet department needs
- Utilizes recruiting and selection tools/processes to build organizational talent
- Delegates work according to employee's abilities and skills
- Evaluates employee's performance and plans for compensation actions in accordance with that performance
- Provides developmental opportunities through identification of internal and external training opportunities
- Creates opportunities for employee growth
- Provides continuous coaching regarding functional and leadership standards (technical skills and behaviors)

SCOPE
- Decision Impact: Division
- Department Responsibility: Single
- Budgetary Responsibility: Yes
- Direct Reports: Yes
- Indirect Reports: No

REQUIRED EDUCATION
- Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing or Communications or equivalent

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
- Minimum 5-7 years related Marketing communications/planning experience.
- Home building and/or real estate industry experience preferred.
- Understanding of advertising law and its application to the homebuilding industry.

- Ability to shift between strategic and tactical responsibilities.
- Understanding of and demonstrated skill at aligning marketing mix with key messages.
- Experience establishing and managing to a budget.
- Effective problem solving, data collection and analysis skills.
- Strong oral and written communication skills.
- Team oriented with ability to establish credibility.

Job Summary
The Selling Sales Manager is responsible for selling new homes in Pulte's conventional communities; promoting Pulte Mortgage; managing and coordinating Sales Trainees and Hostesses; and implementing and maintaining sales policy & procedure.

The schedule for this position includes all non-exempt holidays and weekends.

This position requires onsite attendance 5 days per week in the Boston, Massachusetts area.

Primary Sales Responsibilities
- Maintain knowledge of local markets, competition, Real Estate laws/rules, public opinion, local and national trends and any government proposed regulations related to the home-buying industry. Complete competitive studies for management upon request.

- Manage and maintain signage and marketing trail. Supervise the maintenance of model homes, checking for cleanliness, repairs needed, etc.

- Supervise and coordinate the Sales Host Persons, Sales Associates and Sales Assistants, ensuring that sales center is fully covered, open and operational during stated business hours.

- Plan an effective personal sales presentation and successfully apply that plan. Attain established sales volume goals. Monitor and meet CSMS goals.

- Conduct interviews to all prospects for current/future home sales, make presentations to model visitors, and demonstrate the models, spec homes and the amenities of the community.

- Explain principal and interest payments, taxes, insurance, CC&R's (deed restrictions), homeowner associations and club/golf membership plans.

- Prepare required paperwork for each home sale and for prospective purchasers.

- Promote and represent Pulte Mortgage to buyers. Track and improve capture rate for market.

- Communicate with and assist Pulte Mortgage on customer loan status and requirements to expedite the processing and closing of all cases.

- Keep buyer updated as to construction start and completion dates and remain actively involved in the sales process through closing.

- Communicate properly, to the appropriate departments, any customer requests for information or service.

Management Responsibilities
- Provides continuous coaching with regard to functional and leadership standards (technical skills and behaviors)

- Ensures appropriate staffing to meet department needs

- Utilizes recruiting and selection tools/processes to build organizational talent

- Delegates work according to employee's abilities and skills

- Evaluates employee's performance and plans development opportunities in accordance with that performance

- Provides developmental opportunities through identification of internal and external training opportunities

- Creates opportunities for employee growth

Required Education
- Minimum Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent

- Appropriate license or certifications as required by the state

- Valid Driver’s License because driving is an essential function of this position.

Required Experience
- Related Functional Experience: Minimum of 3-5 years

- Time in position: Minimum of 2 years at a supervisory level

- Knowledge of title and sales procedures and Microsoft Office Software.

- New home sales experience (6 months minimum)

- Computer proficiency (email, work processing, operations, etc)

- Ability to work all posted hours of operation. Opening and closing of model park and sales center must be conducted before and after posted hours

- Ability to work weekends and all non-exempt holidays

Pay Information
$35.00 - $40.00 per hour while in Training
$85,000 annual draw + commissions as Selling Sales Manager
Anticipate pay range of of $85,000 - $200,000 per year, including draw and commissions as a Selling Sales Manager.

All Sales Consultants, except those in CA, are ineligible for paid time off, but receive 8 paid sales holidays in addition to either 23 or 28 days off based on years of service comprised of unpaid time off and paid sick time if applicable in their state. Employees are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) Plan. Employees (and their eligible dependents) are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage.
Employees are covered by company-paid disability, basic life insurance and parental leave. Voluntary insurance coverage options, including critical illness, accident and hospital indemnity, are also available. In addition, the Company offers an Employee Assistance Program and tuition reimbursement (as applicable). Employees may also be eligible for other state required benefits such as paid family and medical leave insurance and/or paid sick time as applicable.

Job Summary:
The Senior Risk Management Analyst is responsible for collecting, analyzing, validating, and presenting the Company's exposure, claims, and insurance data to support risk financing, actuarial analyses, insurance renewals, captive insurance operations, and management decision-making. The position identifies loss trends, cost drivers, and emerging risks, while providing recommendations related to loss control, claims mitigation, and insurance program performance. The role works closely with internal stakeholders, insurance carriers, brokers, actuaries, captive managers, and other external partners.

Primary Responsibilities:
Risk, Finance and Actuarial Activities: Collect, validate, analyze, evaluate loss, claims, and exposure data from multiple internal and external sources. Prepare reports, analyses, and recommendations related to loss control, premium allocation, claims mitigation, and risk financing initiatives. Prepare quarterly actuarial data submissions, loss triangles, and supporting schedules for actuarial analyses. Review and analyze actuarial reports and assess the impact on the Company's insurance programs, captive insurance companies, and risk retention group. Evaluate loss trends, identify root causes and cost drivers, and develop recommendations to improve loss performance and risk management outcomes. Develop, maintain, and analyze division risk allocation methodologies and internal insurance cost allocations.

Risk Financing : Assist with forecasting, budgeting, and financial planning activities associated with the Company's insurance and risk financing programs. Support development and analysis of insurance expense allocations, loss allocations, and cost-benefit analyses. Assist in ensuring compliance with internal controls, financial procedures, and departmental policies. Verify and review expenditures related to departmental accounting and budgeting activities.

Insurance Carrier Interaction: Prepare and distribute quarterly reinsurance billings and carrier loss runs. Monitor loss activity and report on policy limit erosion, aggregate erosion, and significant claims developments. Interact with insurance brokers, carriers, and reinsurers regarding loss data, billing issues, and underwriting information. Prepare and analyze underwriting data and renewal submissions for insurance program renewals. Support insurance marketing and renewal efforts by providing accurate exposure, claims, and financial information.

Captive Management: Assist with preparation and analysis of captive insurance company and risk retention group financial statements. Assist with cash flow projections, reserve analyses, and financial reporting requirements. Support monthly financial closing processes and general ledger reconciliations related to captive insurance operations. Work with external captive managers, actuaries, auditors

SCOPE
- Decision Impact: Function/Organization
- Department Responsibility: Single
- Budgetary Responsibility: No
- Direct Reports: No
- Indirect Reports: No

REQUIRED EDUCATION
- Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Risk Management, Accounting,  Business, or equivalent

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- Related Functional Experience: Minimum of 4 to 7 years’ experience in risk management, insurance, risk finance, actuarial support or finance-related positions
- Knowledge of principles of risk management, property and casualty insurance, actuarial science, insurance industry practices, and accounting.
- Experience working with captive insurance companies or risk retention groups.
- Experience supporting actuarial analysis, reserve studies, or insurance renewals.
- Knowledge of insurance policy language and contracts
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to work effectively with various levels of management and external business partners.
- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and ability to work with large datasets.
- Strong analytical and organizational skills.

The Procurement Director leads procurement operations within a division, ensuring alignment with strategic goals and delivering optimal results in cost efficiency, supplier performance, and compliance. Job Summary
The Manager, People & Culture Analytics is responsible for defining, governing, and executing the People & Culture (P&C) analytics strategy and roadmap. This role serves as the primary owner of workforce reporting, analytics, data governance, and insight generation across the P&C function, partnering closely with P&C Centers of Excellence, P&C Operations, IT, Finance, and business leaders.

Primary Job Responsibilities
Analytics Strategy
- Own, prioritize and execute the People & Culture Analytics roadmap
- Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities for new workforce analytics capabilities that support strategic business objectives.

- Establish analytics success measures and monitor adoption, effectiveness, and business outcomes of delivered solutions.

Reporting & Insights
- Develop and maintain enterprise workforce dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reports.
- Drive self-service reporting capabilities that empower leaders while maintaining governance and data integrity.

Data Integration & Automation
- Lead the design and management of sustainable data pipelines across P&C technologies.
- Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting processes

- Partner with P&C IT and enterprise data teams to improve data accessibility, quality, scalability, and reliability.

- Support future integration, modernization, and platform transformation initiatives.

Data Governance & Architecture
- Establish and maintain the People & Culture Data Dictionary, Business Glossary, and KPI Catalog.
- Develop and maintain semantic models that enable consistent reporting, analytics, AI, and future Microsoft Fabric integration.

Power BI & Analytics Platforms
- Own the People & Culture Power BI ecosystem, including datasets, workspaces, dashboards, security models, and reporting architecture.

- Promote scalable design practices that reduce report redundancy and improve data consistency.

- Lead reporting modernization efforts that replace manual and fragmented reporting with governed, automated solutions.

- Evaluate and recommend emerging analytics, AI, and visualization capabilities that enhance decision-making.

·       Other duties as assigned.

- Decision Impact: Corporate
- Department Responsibility: None
- Budgetary Responsibility: No
- Direct Reports: No
- Indirect Reports: No
- Physical Requirements: Not applicable

Required Education/Experience
- Minimum Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Information Systems, Business, Human Resources, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field.

- 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, HR analytics, workforce planning, or related functions.

Required Licensing, Registration and/or Certifications
- Not Applicable

Required Skills/Knowledge
- Expertise in Power BI data modeling, visualization, and dashboard design.
- Strong understanding of workforce metrics and HR data structures.
- Knowledge of dimensional modeling, semantic models, and data architecture principles.
- Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, metadata management, and reporting standards.
- Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution.
- Experience translating business requirements into analytics solutions.
- Strong project management and prioritization skills.
